messages.subject: [Ann] StatET 3.6.1
messages.body_plain:
Dear StatET users,

I am pleased to announce StatET 3.6.1.

This is a maintenance update; among others, it:
   - Fixes formatting of values in data frames in the R data viewer
   - Fixes scrollbar in hovers
   - Fixes ClassCastException in Queue view

The new version is available for download for Eclipse Neon (4.6) from 
the regular update-site and the homepage now.

Regards,
Stephan


-- 
http://www.walware.de/goto/statet
